comment: PAPER-001-00 inventory of the ACTUAL M24 implementation. Paths are repo-relative; symbols are the real code entry points. No second implementation is created: the paper work reuses these.

m24_gamma_model.description: Flexible discovery current: PCHIP in ln Gamma through six nodes [0, z_low, 0.30, 0.80, 2.00, 10.0], Gamma(10)=1 fixed, node values (g0, g_low, g03, g08, g20) within +/-0.15, z_low in [0.001, 0.20] (M24D range; M24E extends bounds once, not dimensionality). Also u_low_of/z_low_of (log10 parameterization, lines 36-50).

m24_distance_engine.description: Dense low-z quadrature engine (low_z_grid linspace(0,0.05,5001) + main grid + data z): integral = cumulative_trapezoid(Gamma/E_LCDM), D_M = c*integral/(100 h_rd), D_H = c*Gamma/(100 h_rd E), D_L = (1+z) D_M. Public canonical engine also in src/h0cdr/model_cghstc33_background.py (D_M, D_H, D_V, E_effective). Same engine feeds DESI, Pantheon+ and (via the bridge) primitive SH0ES.

m24_joint_likelihood.description: chi2 = chi2_DESI + chi2_CMB(compressed R,l_A,omega_b h2 anchor) + chi2_H0(compressed SH0ES 73.04+/-1.04 Gaussian) + chi2_SN(Pantheon+ HF shape, full stat+sys covariance, profiled additive zero point). All covariances Cholesky-solved (no inv(C)). Bounds-checked via M24D_C2_PARAMETER_BOUNDS / u-layout with u_low in [-3, log10(0.20)].

m24d_runner.description: M24D campaign: profile decision (M24D-006), free low-z rescue with differential_evolution (10 seeds 601-610, popsize 24, maxiter 1200, u_low in [-3, log10(0.05)], Nelder-Mead polish), top-8 distinct functional minima (RMS ln Gamma > 0.01), unchanged M24C gate matrix, compressed-H0 mapping audit, bundle runs/m24d_lowz_sensitivity_bundle.tar.gz.

m24d_result_reader.description: Loads the frozen M24D vector from paper/evidence/m24d_reference/parameters.json (frozen by scripts/paper/freeze_m24d_reference.py from runs/m24d_lowz_sensitivity/best_rescue_candidate.json), rebuilds the workspace via run_m24d_campaign.load_workspace, recomputes the likelihood with no optimizer, and compares against likelihood_components.json with CHI2_ABS_TOL=1e-3 / SCALAR_REL_TOL=1e-6. Verified 2026-08-31: exact replay, Delta chi2 = 33.4618 vs identity baseline 1558.2651.

pantheon_loader.description: Registered, SHA-256-verified Pantheon+SH0ES bundle: sn_pantheon_plus_shoes_full.csv (1701 rows: sn_id, z_hel, z_cmb, mu_obs, is_calibrator_or_anchor, covariance_index; 77 calibrators, 1624 Hubble-flow) + sn_pantheon_plus_shoes_stat_sys_full_covariance.csv (1701x1701) + h0_shoes_riess2022_summary.csv (73.04+/-1.04) + CMB distance prior excerpt/invcov. sn_hubble_flow_indices (line 781) selects HF rows from the registered flag.

pantheon_likelihood.description: Full-covariance Pantheon+ Hubble-flow shape likelihood: submatrix Cholesky factored once, analytic profile of the additive distance-modulus zero point (profile_additive_mu_offset in the adapter, lines 794-849), mu_model = 5 log10((1+z) D_M) + 25 with PROFILE_H0_KM_S_MPC=70 absorbed by the profiled offset.

shoes_loader.description: Official SH0ES 2022 y/L/C ladder (data/external/shoes_2022_ladder/*_shoes_ceph_topantheonwt6.0_112221.fits from PantheonPlusSH0ES/DataRelease c447f0f): y (3492,), L (47, 3492), C (3492, 3492) full covariance, positive-definite validated via cho_factor. Equation classes: Cepheids 0-3129, SN calibrators 3130-3206, external constraint pins 3207-3214, Hubble-flow SN 3215-3491 (X[:,46] == -1 on the 277 HF rows).
reused_by: m24e primitive shoes bridge + overlap audit

shoes_profile_likelihood.description: Full-covariance GLS with Cholesky whitening only (never inv(C) of the 3492x3492 C; only the 47x47 normal matrix is inverted for the parameter covariance). profile_shoes_chi2_at_eta holds the 5logH0-1 column at eta and profiles the other 46 params; baseline_parity reproduces Riess+2022 (H0=73.04+/-1.01, chi2/dof=1.03; frozen baseline H0=73.0428, chi2=3552.75933).

desi_loader.description: Official DESI DR2 BAO combined Gaussian likelihood (13 rows: BGS D_V, LRG1/LRG2/LRG+ELG/ELG/QSO D_M+D_H, LYA D_H+D_M; 13x13 covariance) from data/external/desi_dr2_bao/, SHA-verified against source_manifest.json; DESIBAODatum.z_eff/observable/value with tracer mapping.

desi_likelihood.description: D_M/r_d, D_H/r_d, D_V/r_d model via the dense-grid engine; whitened residual through the 13x13 Cholesky (workspace.bao_cholesky); standalone chi2 also in desi_dr2_bao.chi2 (line 257).

cmb_anchor.description: Compressed early-Universe anchor: (R = sqrt(Omega_m) * shifted distance integral, l_A = pi*D_M(z*)/r_s(z*), omega_b h^2 fixed at registered value) against the registered Planck 2018 TT/TE/EE low-z distance-prior excerpt inverse covariance (3x3), with r_d anchor 147.05 Mpc and r_s(z*)=144.43 Mpc on a dedicated recombination grid. In the M24C/D joint objective the same 3x3 inverse covariance is used directly (m24d_lowz_workspace.py lines 267-278).

hard_rule_notes.shoes_linear_system_machinery: The official SH0ES 2022 measurement-level y/L/C machinery (ShoesLinearSystem, full covariance, Cholesky solves, baseline H0~=73.04 chi2/dof~=1.03) already exists in src/h0cdr/likelihoods/shoes_ladder.py per the M13 authorization and is REUSED, not reimplemented.
hard_rule_notes.no_compressed_gaussian_in_paper_mode: The compressed ((H0_eff-73.04)/1.04)^2 term (LocalH0Likelihood in src/h0cdr/likelihoods/m24b_local_h0.py) stays for M24D replay only; the M24E paper-grade likelihood replaces it with the primitive ladder (M24E-005).
hard_rule_notes.row_mapping: Ladder FITS carry no row ids; M24E establishes the source-backed numeric join (y construction: y_HF = m_i - 5 log10(c z_cmb) - 24; global join constant against registered MU_SH0ES) in src/h0cdr/likelihoods/m24_shoes.py before any row-targeted delta_y insertion.
